Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION FOR BAG, SLEEPING, KAPOK-FILLED

o.

FO R E W 0 R D

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian St andards Institution on 28 September 1983, after the draft finali zed b y the Travel R equisites Sectional Committee had been approved by t he Consu m er Products and Medical Instruments Division Cou ncil.
0.2 Sleeping bags are generall}' used on mo unt a ins or on hi gh a lt it ud e where th e ambient temperature is very low a nd climate is hum id and stormy. These bags may also be used by Defen ce personnel a nd civi lia ns, who are to mo ve from place to place a n d take shelter in te mporary hutrnents like tents . 0.3 Assistance has been d eri ved from provi sional specifica tion .l\o.CIT &CiTC-6/21 'Specification for bag, sleeping, MK-4' issued by Ministry of Defence, Go vernment of India, in the preparation of this stand ard. 0.4 This standa rd conta ins cla use s wh ich ca ll for agreement between the purchaser and the supplier and which perm it the pu rchaser to lise his option for selection to suit h is require me nts . The relevant clauses are 4.1, 5.2 and 8.1. 0.5 For the purpose of deciding whe the r a p art icu lar requirement of th is standard is com plied with , the final value, observed or ca lculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960�. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the sp ecified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE
1.1 This standard covers the requirements for sleeping bag , kapok-filled,
"Rul es fo r round ing off n u mvrical va lue s ;' rerisrd ),

IS

I

10674 - 1983

2. SIZES
2.1 Sleeping bags shall be of the following sizes ( sre also Table I ):

Size
Extra large Large

Length

1980 mm 1850 mm I 730 mm 1 600 mrn

Medium
Small

3. SHAPE AND DIMENSIONS
3.1 The shape and design ofsleeping bag shall be as shown in Fig. I to 3. 3.2 The leading dimensions of sleeping bag and its components and tolerances thereon, shall conform to those gh"en in Table l . 3.2.1 The d imensions o f the bag and its inner liner shall be measured when laid flat on the table after removal of the wrinkles and creases.

4. MATERIALS
4.1 The various components of the sleeping bag shall be made from materials specified in Table 2. Materials, not specifically designated, shall be suitable for the purpose intended.

5. WORKMANSIDP AND FINISH
5.1 The sleeping bag including the body, the face-flap and the inner liner shall be made to the desig n and dimensions as shown in Fig. I, 2 and 3. 5.2 The colour of the cloth for the main body and the various components shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 5.3 The body of the bag shall be made in two pieces and shall be assemb led later to form a cylindrical bag. 5.4 Each p iece of the body of the bag shall be mad e sepa ra tel y from two la yers of fabric to form a case. The component casing shall be uniformly stuffed with grade 2 Indian kapok and qu ilted by hand or machinestitched forming squares of 150 mm width. Number of stitches shall be 4 to 6 per 25 mm for hand q uilting and 5 to 6 per 25 mm for machine stitching. The kapok filling shall be of unifor m compactness.

5.5 A narrow casing measuring 100 X 960 mm in size sh all be made from specified fabric a nd the web sh all be stitched lengthwise on the casing. The half portion of slide fastener together with casing shall be stitched to one side of the opening and the other half portion of the slide fa stener shall be stitched to the other side of the opening. The casings shall then be filled with Grade 2 kapok and machine stitched. Fi ve equispaced buttons on each side of the zip opening be attached on the inner side of the main body to correspond with button holes in the liner. 5.6 Upper surface of the body of the bag shall then be cut half way from the face opening along the length up to a distance of 910 mm, 5.7 The face flap consisting of two square pieces of 280 mm ea ch shall be cut from specified fabric and stitched to form a pad. It shall be filled with Grade 2 Indian kapok and machine-stitched. The face flap shall then be stitched on to the top portion of the face opening so as to complete the assembly. The two pieces of the main body shall then be stit ched together by me ans of a single row of machine stitching. While stitching the body pieces, 19 securing tapes 150 mm long and 12'5 mm wide shall be properly positioned all-round the periphery equally spaced to correspond to the securing tapes attached to the liner.

6. SAMPUNG
6.1 Unless otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier the procedure gh-en in IS: 2500 (Part 1 )-1973* shall be followed for sampling. The inspection level and sampling plan as given in 6.2 and 6.3 shall be followed. 6.2 The scale of sampling shall correspond to inspection level III given in T a ble I of IS: 2500 ( Part 1 )- 1973* for all the requirements specified in this standard.. 6.3 The sampling plan shall correspond to AQL plans of 4'0 percent given in Table :2 o f IS: 2500( Part I) - 1973*.

7. MARKING
7.1 Each sleeping bag shall be legibly and permanently marked with the following: a) b) c) d)
Manufacturer's name or initials or registered trade- m ark, Size, Batch in code or otherwise, and Month and year of manufacture.
Inspection by attributes and by count of

7.2 The sleeping bag may also be marked with th e lSI Certification :M a rk .
NOTE - The use of the lSI Certification Mark is govern ed h y the provision! of the Indian St andards Institutiun (Certifi cation Marks ) Act and the Rules a nd Regu larions made thereunder. The lSI Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that t hev have been prod uced to compl y with the requirements of that standard under a well-d efin ed system of inspection , testing and qualit y co nt ro l which is d e vised and supervis ed b y lSI and op erated bv the produ cer. lSI marked product! are abo continuousl y ch ecked by lSI fo r conformity to that standard as a further safeguard . Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of th e lSI Cert ificarion M ark may be grant ed to manufactu r ers or processors, may be obtained from the Indi an Standards Institution.

8. PACKING
8. I The sleepi ng bag shall be packed to ensure safe transportation. They may also be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
